I have enough context on the architecture. Here's the complete file list and changes:

## Worker (Hono/D1)

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| **`worker/src/routes/shop.ts`** | Add `shopRoutes.post('/rest', ...)` endpoint: read `{ characterId, sessionId }`, load character via `getCharacter`, compute `cost` (e.g. flat gold value or `COST_PER_HP * (max_hp - hp)`), validate `character.gold >= cost` (400 if not) and `hp < max_hp` (optionally no-op/error if already full), then `updateCharacter(db, id, { hp: character.max_hp, gold: character.gold - cost })`, return `{ success, cost, updatedCharacter }`. |
| **`worker/src/types/index.ts`** | Add `RestBody { sessionId: string; characterId: string }` interface and a constant like `REST_COST_PER_HP = 1` (or `INN_FLAT_COST = 10`) near the other rule constants. |
| **`worker/src/services/character.ts`** | No new function strictly required — reuse existing `getCharacter`/`updateCharacter`. (Optional: add a small `restAtInn(db, character)` helper to keep the route thin.) |
| **`worker/src/index.ts`** | No change if reusing `/api/shop/rest`; only needed if you instead create a dedicated `worker/src/routes/rest.ts` file, which would require `import { restRoutes } from './routes/rest.js'` and `app.route('/api/rest', restRoutes)`. |
| **`worker/migrations/0002_*.sql`** | Only needed if the cost/location should be data-driven (e.g. seeding an "Inn" row in the `shops` table with a configurable price); not required for a flat/hardcoded cost. |

## Angular Frontend

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| **`frontend/src/app/models/game.models.ts`** | Add `RestBody`/`RestResponse` types mirroring the worker's (`{ cost, updatedCharacter }`), since this file duplicates worker types rather than importing them. |
| **`frontend/src/app/services/game-api.service.ts`** | Add `restAtInn(sessionId: string, characterId: string): Observable<{ success: boolean; cost: number; updatedCharacter: Character }>` calling `POST ${API_BASE}/api/shop/rest`. |
| **`frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.ts`** | Add `restAtInn()` method: guard on `!loading()`, call `api.restAtInn(...)`, on success `charSvc.setCharacter(res.updatedCharacter)` and `pushEntry('system', ...)`, on error push the gold-shortfall message from `err.error.error`. |
| **`frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.html`** | Add a "Rest at Inn" button (disabled while `inCombat()` or `loading()`) calling `restAtInn()`, likely near the suggested-actions/inventory button area. |
| **`frontend/src/app/services/character-state.service.ts`** | No change needed — `setCharacter` already recomputes `hpPercent` from the signal. |

No DB schema changes are strictly required since `characters.hp`/`gold` columns already exist.
